{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit sweater: fitted, crew neck, long sleeves, hip-length, soft cream #F1E6D0, extra-fine merino wool

Maxi skirt: high-waisted A-line, falls to the ankle, deep green-teal #2E5B54, fluid matte crepe with a soft drape

Textured jacket: slightly tailored, single-breasted, hip-length with a straight hem, warm taupe-brown #6B5648, wool bouclé

Ankle boots: almond toe, block heel of about 5 cm, dark chocolate #3A2B24, smooth leather

Small clutch: structured, flat, with a slim chain strap, antique gold #B08D57, matte leather

Drop earrings: slim and delicate, polished warm gold #C9A24D, metal

Why this outfit works: The skirt is the long maxi she asked for, and the block-heeled ankle boots give her the 4–6 cm heel while staying steady through a long evening. The cream knit and textured jacket give the neat, polished look that suits a theatre in autumn, and the jacket keeps her warm on the way there and back. The deep green-teal echoes her grey-green eyes, and the cream and warm taupe flatter her golden hair and warm skin.
